declarations.name: DEMO_MAP_ID
declarations.description: Google's shared test map ID. Advanced markers and route markers need a map ID; create your own for production.

An interactive Google map. Markers and routes are declared as children; everything else the Maps JavaScript API
offers (Street View through the pegman, map types, traffic layers, clustering, …) stays reachable through the
underlying `google.maps.Map` on GoogleMap.map.

The API is loaded once per page, from `configureGoogleMaps({ apiKey })` or this element's `api-key`. The key is a
browser key, visible to the page by design: restrict it to your sites' referrers and to the APIs you use.

The map's light or dark look follows the CSS `color-scheme` computed on the element when the map is created.
declarations.name: GoogleMap

cssProperties.description: Colour of the loading and error notice.
cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map__message--color

slots.description: `c2-google-map-marker` and `c2-google-map-route` elements. They render nothing in place.

members.name: center
members.description: Map centre, written `"lat,lng"`. Updated as the user pans. Without it the map shows the world.

members.name: zoom
members.description: Zoom level, from 0 (the world) to about 22 (buildings). Updated as the user zooms.

members.name: mapId
members.description:
A map ID from the Google Cloud console: cloud-based styling, vector rendering, and required by markers.
Defaults to Google's `DEMO_MAP_ID`, which is meant for development only. Read when the map is created.

members.name: mapType
members.description: The base map: `roadmap`, `satellite`, `hybrid` or `terrain`.

members.name: gestureHandling
members.description:
How the map answers scroll and touch gestures. `cooperative` asks for two fingers or Ctrl + scroll so the page
can still scroll past it; `greedy` takes every gesture; `none` freezes it.

members.name: disableDefaultUi
members.description: Hides every built-in control: zoom, map type, Street View, fullscreen.

members.name: options
members.description: Any other `google.maps.MapOptions`, applied over the attributes. Property only.

members.name: #reported
members.description: The view the map reported last, so writing it back to `center`/`zoom` does not move the map again.

members.name: loadingMessage
members.description: What to say while loading, e.g. "Loading map…".

members.name: map
members.description: The underlying `google.maps.Map`, once it exists.

members.name: ready
members.description: Resolves with the `google.maps.Map` once it exists. Children wait on it.

members.name: fitBounds
members.description: Pans and zooms so every point is in view.

members.name: showStreetView
members.description: Opens Street View on this map, at `position` or at the map centre.

members.name: initialize
members.description: Builds the Google object inside canvas and sets `status` to `ready` when it shows. Called once, after the first render.

members.name: apiKey
members.description: A browser API key, restricted to your HTTP referrers. Ignored when `configureGoogleMaps({ apiKey })` was called.

members.name: canvas
members.description: Where Google draws. Present from the first render on.

members.name: #retry
members.description: Starts again after a missing key: one set from script, or configured once an app has read its settings.

members.name: fail
members.description: Shows `error` in place of the map and reports it through `map-error`.

events.name: map-click
events.description: Fired when the user clicks the map. `detail` holds the `lat`/`lng`, and the `placeId` of a clicked point of interest.

events.name: map-ready
events.description: Fired once the map exists. `detail.map` is the `google.maps.Map`.

events.name: view-change
events.description: Fired when the map settles after a pan or zoom, with its `center`, `zoom` and `bounds`.

events.name: map-error
events.description: Fired when the map cannot be shown. `detail.reason` is `missing-key`, `load-failed`, `auth-failed` or `no-imagery`.

declarations.description:
A marker on the `c2-google-map` it is placed in, drawn as a Google Advanced Marker. The pin's colours come from
the CSS variables below, read when the marker is drawn; set `content` for a marker of your own.

```html
<c2-google-map center="10.7769,106.7009" zoom="14">
  <c2-google-map-marker position="10.7769,106.7009" label="Office" glyph="HQ"></c2-google-map-marker>
</c2-google-map>
```
declarations.name: GoogleMapMarker

cssProperties.description: Colour of the glyph text, or of the dot when there is no glyph.
cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map-marker__glyph--color

cssProperties.description: Size of the pin relative to Google's default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map-marker__pin--scale

members.name: position
members.description: Where the marker stands, written `"lat,lng"`. Updated when the user drags it.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the marker, also shown as its tooltip.

members.name: glyph
members.description: A short text drawn inside the pin, such as a letter or a number.

members.name: draggable
members.description: Lets the user move the marker.

members.name: zIndex
members.description: Stacking order among markers; higher is on top.

members.name: content
members.description: A node to show instead of the pin. Property only.

members.name: marker
members.description: The underlying `google.maps.marker.AdvancedMarkerElement`, once it is on a map.

members.name: #apply
members.description: `redraw` rebuilds the pin, which reads the colour variables again.

events.name: marker-drag-end
events.description: Fired when the user drops a `draggable` marker. `detail` is the new position, which `position` also holds.

declarations.description:
The road route from `origin` to `destination`, computed by the Google Routes API and drawn on the
`c2-google-map` it is placed in, with lettered markers at its ends. The map zooms to fit it. The route is
computed again whenever an end, a stop or the travel mode changes; `route-change` reports its distance and time.

Needs the Routes API enabled on the key.

```html
<c2-google-map>
  <c2-google-map-route origin="Ben Thanh Market, Ho Chi Minh City" destination="10.7880,106.7058"></c2-google-map-route>
</c2-google-map>
```
declarations.name: GoogleMapRoute

cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map-route__line--width

cssProperties.description: Colour of the edge drawn around the line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map-route__outline--color

cssProperties.description: Width of that edge on each side, in pixels; `0` removes it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-google-map-route__outline--width

members.name: origin
members.description: Where the route starts: `"lat,lng"`, an address, a plus code or a place name.

members.name: destination
members.description: Where the route ends, in the same forms as `origin`.

members.name: waypoints
members.description: Stops between the ends, as a JSON array of the same forms (`'["10.78,106.70", "Tan Dinh Market"]'`).

members.name: travelMode
members.description: How the route is travelled: `driving`, `walking`, `bicycling`, `transit` or `two-wheeler`.

members.name: hideMarkers
members.description: Leaves out the lettered markers at the ends and stops.

members.name: noFit
members.description: Keeps the map's view instead of zooming to the route.

members.name: #request
members.description: Counts requests so a slow answer cannot overwrite a newer one.

members.name: route
members.description: The computed `google.maps.routes.Route`, once there is one.

members.name: distanceMeters
members.description: Length of the drawn route in metres.

members.name: durationMillis
members.description: Travel time of the drawn route in milliseconds.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Computes the route again, for instance after the traffic has had time to change.

events.name: route-change
events.description: Fired when a route has been computed and drawn, with its `distanceMeters`, `durationMillis`, their formatted `distanceText`/`durationText`, the `path` and the Google `route`.

events.name: route-error
events.description: Fired when no route could be computed: an end Google cannot find, no road between the ends, or the Routes API not enabled on the key.

declarations.description:
A Google Street View panorama. Give it a `position` to look around a place, or link it to a map with `for`: the
map's pegman then opens Street View here instead of over the map, and the map's markers show in the panorama.

```html
<c2-google-street-view position="48.8584,2.2945" heading="320" pitch="10"></c2-google-street-view>
```

cssProperties.name: --c2-google-street-view__message--color

members.description: Where to stand, written `"lat,lng"`. Google picks the nearest panorama. Updated as the user walks.

members.name: pano
members.description: A panorama ID, instead of a `position`.

members.name: heading
members.description: Compass direction the camera faces, in degrees (0 is north, 90 east).

members.name: pitch
members.description: Camera angle up or down, in degrees, from -90 to 90.

members.name: zoom
members.description: Camera zoom, from 0 (widest) to about 4.

members.name: for
members.description: The `id` of a `c2-google-map` whose pegman opens Street View here.
